native_observations: Four intertwined apparently nude colored complete figures form a ring around an empty diamond-like center, no central face or sun disk.
Eight isolated portrait medallions surround the central group: four corner large heads and four smaller cardinal heads.
Central arms and legs overlap and grip one another; no separate plant, mobility rod, linked hanging strand or raised flask resolved in their hands.
Upper-left outer portrait has tall repeated plant-like crown/wreath strokes; this is head decoration, not a held flower.
Two upper large heads look younger; lower large heads bearded/older-looking. Exact ages not read.
No separate outer feather/plume forms, star field, celestial sun/moon pair or wavy cloud enclosure resolved on this folio.
Short Greek labels occur next to all eight portrait medallions and on four colored bands around the interlocked group; bottom handwritten paragraph/inscription also present.
